bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
psql(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$1"; }
all="$(psql "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile'")"
if test "$all" -eq 0; then exit 31; fi
named="$(psql "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' AND title='みんなのプロフ'")"
if test "$named" -lt 3; then exit 32; fi
grouped="$(psql "SELECT count(DISTINCT board_key) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' AND title='みんなのプロフ' AND ((board_key='area_bbs' AND chat_id=-1003847210571) OR (board_key='video_chat' AND chat_id=-1002373696859) OR (board_key='gay_board' AND chat_id=-1003770334893))")"
if test "$grouped" -lt 3; then exit 33; fi
verified="$(psql "SELECT count(DISTINCT board_key) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL AND title='みんなのプロフ' AND ((board_key='area_bbs' AND chat_id=-1003847210571) OR (board_key='video_chat' AND chat_id=-1002373696859) OR (board_key='gay_board' AND chat_id=-1003770334893))")"
if test "$verified" -lt 3; then exit 34; fi
release="$(psql "SELECT count(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='profile' AND enabled=TRUE AND length(source_commit)=40 AND length(trim(ci_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0 AND approved_by IS NOT NULL")"
if test "$release" -ne 1; then exit 35; fi
echo PROFILE_BOARD_RELEASE_READY=PASS
